```yaml
    skills: [outcome-review]
    reviewers: [privacy-reviewer]
    output: "docs/outcome-readings.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
gate: "Readings complete"
criteria:
  - "Date, segment, source and recorder on every reading"
checks:
  - "Second-analyst spot check"
on_failure:
  - "Restore from the log history and record the correction as a new reading"
  - "Back-fill from source data with a caveat"
rework: "Query error → re-run and record a correcting reading"
outputs:
  - "docs/outcome-readings.md"
handoff: "Outcome readings log → 8.1.4 Hold the Outcome Review (and 8.2.2 for gap analysis)"
learning:
  - "Confounders that distorted readings — learning log"
```

files.body:
# Workflow 8.1.4.1 · Run the Outcome Review

At the by-date, set every reading against its target and the value hypothesis, explain the gaps, decide continue, change course or stop, and record it.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-1-4-1-outcome-review.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-1-4-1-run-outcome-review`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-1-4-1-outcome-review
title: "Run the Outcome Review"
owner: "Product manager (judge)"
inputs:
  - "docs/outcome-readings.md"
  - "docs/measurement-plan.md"
  - "docs/opportunity-brief.md"
  - "docs/insight-synthesis.md"
preconditions:
  - "Readings complete to the by-date"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Assemble readings vs plan"
    owner: "Data analyst"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-1-4-1-s1-assemble-readings-vs-plan
    skills: [goal-question-metric]
    reviewers: [data-reviewer]
    output: "docs/outcome-readings.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s2
    do: "Reconcile realised value"
    owner: "Finance partner"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-1-4-1-s2-reconcile-realised-value
    skills: [benefits-realisation-management]
    reviewers: [finance-reviewer]
    output: "docs/value-reconciliation.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s3
    do: "Explain gaps with insights"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-1-4-1-s3-explain-gaps-with-insights
    skills: [comparison-group, five-whys, leading-and-lagging-indicators]
    reviewers: [customer-reviewer, operations-reviewer]
    output: "docs/outcome-report.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "Gap unexplained → more evidence (8.2)": s1
  - id: d1
    decision: "Continue, change course or stop?"
    owner: "Product manager (judge)"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Product manager (judge) decides
    branches:
      "yes": s4
      "Value outside range / target change → portfolio board": authority
      "Stop pursuing → record and route to 8.4": stop
  - id: s4
    do: "Record & sign the outcome report"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-1-4-1-s4-record-and-sign-the-outcome-report
    skills: [itil-4, retrospective]
    reviewers: [business-reviewer]
    output: "docs/outcome-report.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
gate: "Outcome Review"
criteria:
  - "Every criterion judged"
  - "Gaps evidenced"
  - "Value agreed with finance"
checks:
  - "Judge ≠ recorder"
  - "Finance agreement"
on_failure:
  - "Portfolio board refuses the next review slot without an outcome report"
  - "Re-run the review against the brief's criteria"
rework: "Unexplained gap → gather evidence in 8.2 and re-review"
outputs:
  - "docs/outcome-report.md"
  - "docs/value-reconciliation.md"
handoff: "Outcome report (OUT-###) → 8.4 Portfolio Review; gaps → 8.2.3 Triage into Improvement Items"
learning:
  - "Predicted vs realised value fed back to DISCOVER sizing — learning log"
```

```yaml
owner: "Product ops"
inputs:

  - id: s2
```

files.body:
# Workflow 8.2.2.1 · Synthesise Insights from Signals

Cluster the period's signals, quantify and explain each theme, and publish only the insights that survive peer review.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-2-2-1-synthesise.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-2-2-1-run-synthesise`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-2-2-1-synthesise
title: "Synthesise Insights from Signals"
owner: "UX researcher"
inputs:
  - "docs/signal-inventory.md"
  - "docs/outcome-readings.md"
preconditions:
  - "Signal inventory published"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Cluster signals by theme"
    owner: "UX researcher"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-2-2-1-s1-cluster-signals-by-theme
    skills: [affinity-clustering, thematic-analysis]
    reviewers: [customer-reviewer, ux-reviewer, synthesiser]
    output: "docs/insight-synthesis.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s2
    do: "Quantify themes with data"
    owner: "Data analyst"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-2-2-1-s2-quantify-themes-with-data
    skills: [cohort-analysis]
    reviewers: [data-reviewer, ai-reviewer, synthesiser]
    output: "docs/insight-synthesis.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s3
    do: "Trace causes & write insights"
    owner: "UX researcher"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-2-2-1-s3-trace-causes-and-write-insights
    skills: [five-whys, fishbone-diagram, insight-synthesis, design-thinking]
    reviewers: [domain-reviewer, operations-reviewer, synthesiser]
    output: "docs/insight-synthesis.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "Challenges strategy → sponsor": authority
  - id: d1
    decision: "Insight holds up in peer review?"
    owner: "Peer reviewer"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Peer reviewer decides
    branches:
      "yes": s4
      "Weak → re-cluster or gather evidence": s1
      "Nothing survives → 'no change indicated'": stop
  - id: s4
    do: "Publish insight synthesis"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-2-2-1-s4-publish-insight-synthesis
    reviewers: [product-reviewer, synthesiser]
    output: "docs/insight-synthesis.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
gate: "Insight validation"
criteria:
  - "Two or more independent kinds of evidence"
  - "Confidence stated"
checks:
  - "Peer review"
on_failure:
  - "Require a second kind of evidence before publishing"
  - "Rewrite as observation + cause + implication"
rework: "Weak insight → re-cluster or gather more evidence"
outputs:
  - "docs/insight-synthesis.md"
handoff: "Insight synthesis → 8.2.3 Triage into Improvement Items; gap insights → 8.1.4 Hold the Outcome Review"
learning:
  - "Insights that contradicted DISCOVER — learning log and DISCOVER"
```

# Workflow 8.2.3.1 · Triage & Route Improvements

Write an improvement item for every insight, gap and recurring retro action, size it, route it to the backlog that will do it and get the receiver to accept it.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-2-3-1-triage.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-2-3-1-run-triage`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-2-3-1-triage
title: "Triage & Route Improvements"
owner: "Product manager"
inputs:
  - "docs/insight-synthesis.md"
  - "docs/outcome-report.md"
  - "docs/retrospective-actions.md"
preconditions:
  - "Insights validated"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Write improvement items"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-2-3-1-s1-write-improvement-items
    skills: [itil-4]
    reviewers: [product-reviewer]
    output: "docs/improvement-backlog.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s2
    do: "Size each item"
    owner: "Product owner"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-2-3-1-s2-size-each-item
    skills: [wsjf, cost-of-delay]
    reviewers: [engineering-reviewer, researcher]
    output: "docs/improvement-backlog.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: d1
    decision: "Route: PLAN, DISCOVER, problem, debt, ops or drop?"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Product manager decides
    branches:
      "yes": s3
      "Cross-product → portfolio board": authority
      "Drop with reason": stop
  - id: s3
    do: "Hand to receiving owner"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-2-3-1-s3-hand-to-receiving-owner
    skills: [backlog-refinement]
    reviewers: [support-reviewer]
    output: "docs/improvement-backlog.md"

    on:
      "Owner rejects → re-route": d1
  - id: s4

criteria:
  - "Every item routed or dropped with reason"
checks:
  - "Receiver acceptance"
on_failure:
  - "Weekly check of unaccepted items; mediate or re-route"
  - "Re-triage against the route rules"
rework: "Owner rejects → re-route or re-size"
outputs:
  - "docs/improvement-backlog.md"
  - "docs/product-backlog.md"
  - "docs/opportunity-signal.md"
  - "docs/problem-record.md"
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
handoff: "Improvement items → PLAN (product backlog), DISCOVER (request), problem backlog or 8.3.1; → 8.2.4 Close the Feedback Loop"
learning:
  - "Share of improvement items done within a quarter — learning log"
```

Pull debt evidence from analysis, delivery trends, incidents and end-of-life notices, confirm it with engineers and register each item blamelessly with an owner.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-3-1-1-register-debt.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-3-1-1-run-register-debt`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-3-1-1-register-debt
title: "Find & Register Debt"
owner: "Engineering lead"
inputs:
  - "docs/problem-record.md"
  - "docs/retrospective-actions.md"
  - "docs/operational-signals.md"
preconditions:
  - "Service live"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Pull debt evidence (analysis, DORA, incidents, end-of-life)"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-1-1-s1-pull-debt-evidence-analysis-dora-incidents-end-of-life
    skills: [dora-metrics, sre]
    reviewers: [devops-reviewer, reliability-reviewer, vendor-reviewer, synthesiser]
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s2
    do: "Run debt-finding session"
    owner: "Engineers"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-1-1-s2-run-debt-finding-session
    skills: [retrospective, five-whys]
    reviewers: [engineering-reviewer, synthesiser]
    output: "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s3
    do: "Classify by quadrant & source"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-1-1-s3-classify-by-quadrant-and-source
    skills: [technical-debt-quadrant]
    reviewers: [architecture-reviewer]
    output: "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "Security-critical → security officer": authority
  - id: d1
    decision: "Real debt — not a feature or a duplicate?"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Engineering lead decides
    branches:
      "yes": s4
      "Unclear → restate": s2
      "Not debt → close with a note": stop
  - id: s4
    do: "Register with owner"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-1-1-s4-register-with-owner
    skills: [fitness-functions]
    reviewers: [engineering-reviewer]
    output: "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
gate: "Debt recorded"
criteria:
  - "Quadrant, source and owner"
checks:
  - "Peer review"
on_failure:
  - "Blameless framing; record the context, not the person"
  - "Subscribe to vendor notices; add an end-of-life watch"
rework: "Unclear item → restate with evidence"
outputs:
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
handoff: "Tech-debt register → 8.3.2 Assess Interest & Risk"
learning:
  - "Debt sources that recur — learning log for DESIGN and BUILD"
```

files.body:
# Workflow 8.3.1.2 · Watch End-of-Life Dates

Each quarter, check every versioned dependency and vendor component for end-of-support dates and register anything due within a year as debt with a deadline.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-3-1-2-end-of-life-watch.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-3-1-2-run-end-of-life-watch`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-3-1-2-end-of-life-watch
title: "Watch End-of-Life Dates"
owner: "Engineering lead"
inputs:
  - "docs/service-inventory.md"
  - "docs/operational-signals.md"
preconditions:
  - "Dependency list or SBOM available"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "List versioned dependencies & vendor components"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-1-2-s1-list-versioned-dependencies-and-vendor-components
    reviewers: [vendor-reviewer, researcher, synthesiser]
    output: "docs/service-inventory.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s2
    do: "Check support and end-of-life dates"
    owner: "Engineer"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-1-2-s2-check-support-and-end-of-life-dates
    skills: [technical-risk-assessment]
    reviewers: [vendor-reviewer, security-reviewer]
    output: "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "Already unsupported with known vulnerabilities → security officer": authority
  - id: d1
    decision: "End of support within 12 months?"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Engineering lead decides
    branches:
      "yes": s3
      "Nothing due → re-check next quarter": s1
  - id: s3
    do: "Register as debt with deadline"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-1-2-s3-register-as-debt-with-deadline
    skills: [technical-debt-quadrant]
    reviewers: [engineering-reviewer]
    output: "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
gate: "End-of-life checked"
criteria:
  - "Every component checked"
  - "Due items registered with deadlines"
checks:
  - "Quarterly review"
on_failure:
  - "Subscribe to vendor notices; add to the quarterly check"
  - "Register at once with cost of delay High"
rework: "Missing dates → ask the vendor and record the answer"
outputs:
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
handoff: "Tech-debt items with deadlines → 8.3.2 Assess Interest & Risk"
learning:
  - "End-of-life dates found late — learning log"
```

files.title: Workflow 8.3.2.1 · Score & Rank the Debt
files.body:
# Workflow 8.3.2.1 · Score & Rank the Debt

Estimate each item's interest, risk and deadline, score it against features with WSJF and agree the rank with the product owner.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-3-2-1-rank-debt.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-3-2-1-run-rank-debt`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-3-2-1-rank-debt
title: "Score & Rank the Debt"
owner: "Engineering lead"
inputs:
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
  - "docs/risk-register.md"
preconditions:
  - "Debt recorded"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Estimate interest per item"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-2-1-s1-estimate-interest-per-item
    skills: [debt-interest-estimate, dora-metrics]
    reviewers: [engineering-reviewer]
    output: "docs/debt-assessment.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s2
    do: "Rate risk & deadlines"
    owner: "Architect"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-2-1-s2-rate-risk-and-deadlines
    skills: [risk-matrix, risk-register]
    reviewers: [security-reviewer, vendor-reviewer]
    output: "docs/debt-assessment.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "Above appetite → risk owner": authority
  - id: s3
    do: "Score WSJF against features"
    owner: "Product owner"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-2-1-s3-score-wsjf-against-features
    skills: [wsjf, cost-of-delay, weighted-scoring, multi-level-backlog]
    reviewers: [product-reviewer, finance-reviewer, challenger]
    output: "docs/debt-assessment.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: d1
    decision: "Fix now, plan, or accept?"
    owner: "Product owner"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Product owner decides
    branches:
      "yes": s4
      "Estimates challenged → re-estimate": s1
      "Accept → record with revisit date": stop
  - id: s4
    do: "Update register; record accepted debt"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-2-1-s4-update-register-record-accepted-debt
    reviewers: [governance-reviewer]
    output: "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
gate: "Debt ranked"
criteria:
  - "Interest as a range"
  - "Deadlines recorded"
checks:
  - "Joint rank agreement"
on_failure:
  - "Deadline-driven cost of delay set to High"
  - "Re-estimate from repository and incident history"
rework: "Estimates challenged → re-estimate with evidence"
outputs:
  - "docs/debt-assessment.md"
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
handoff: "Ranked register & debt interest assessment → 8.3.3 Plan Paydown & Modernisation"
learning:
  - "Interest estimates vs actual cost later — learning log"
```

```yaml
orchestration: evolve-8-3-2-assess
```

files.title: Workflow 8.3.3.1 · Plan the Modernisation
files.body:
# Workflow 8.3.3.1 · Plan the Modernisation

Group related debt, choose an approach per component, slice it into releasable steps with capacity and exit criteria, and get it approved.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-3-3-1-plan-modernisation.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-3-3-1-run-plan-modernisation`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-3-3-1-plan-modernisation
title: "Plan the Modernisation"
owner: "Architect"
inputs:
  - "docs/debt-assessment.md"
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
preconditions:
  - "Register ranked"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Group related debt"
    owner: "Architect"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-3-1-s1-group-related-debt
    reviewers: [architecture-reviewer]
    output: "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s2
    do: "Choose approach (7 Rs)"
    owner: "Architect"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-3-1-s2-choose-approach-7-rs
    skills: [7-rs-of-modernisation, trade-off-analysis, spike]
    reviewers: [architecture-reviewer, vendor-reviewer, infrastructure-reviewer, synthesiser]
    output: "docs/modernisation-plan.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "No viable approach → accept with revisit date": stop
  - id: s3
    do: "Slice into releasable steps"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-3-1-s3-slice-into-releasable-steps
    skills: [strangler-fig, parallel-run]
    reviewers: [engineering-reviewer, data-reviewer]
    output: "docs/modernisation-plan.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s4
    do: "Set capacity & exit criteria"
    owner: "Product owner"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-3-1-s4-set-capacity-and-exit-criteria
    skills: [fitness-functions, capacity-allocation-for-debt, pre-mortem]
    reviewers: [reliability-reviewer, product-reviewer]
    output: "docs/modernisation-plan.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: d1
    decision: "Approve in flow, or needs funding?"
    owner: "Product owner"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Product owner decides
    branches:
      "yes": gate
      "Not sliced → re-slice": s3
      "Needs funding / structural change → portfolio or architecture board": authority
gate: "Modernisation plan approved"
criteria:
  - "Releasable slices"
  - "Measurable exit"
  - "Rollback defined"
checks:
  - "Architect and product owner review"
on_failure:
  - "Strangler-fig slicing workshop"
  - "Add fitness functions before approval"
rework: "Not sliced → re-slice"
outputs:
  - "docs/modernisation-plan.md"
  - "docs/product-backlog.md"
handoff: "Modernisation plan → 8.4 Portfolio Review (funding) and PLAN (slices); → 8.3.4 Track Paydown & Fitness"
learning:
  - "Approaches that worked per kind of debt — learning log"
```

files.title: Workflow 8.3.4.1 · Verify Paydown
files.body:
# Workflow 8.3.4.1 · Verify Paydown

Track each paydown slice, run its fitness function and mark the debt paid only when the check passes and the interest has gone.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-3-4-1-verify-paydown.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-3-4-1-run-verify-paydown`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-3-4-1-verify-paydown
title: "Verify Paydown"
owner: "Engineering lead"
inputs:
  - "docs/modernisation-plan.md"
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
preconditions:
  - "Slices in delivery"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Track slices vs plan"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-4-1-s1-track-slices-vs-plan
    skills: [kanban, capacity-allocation-for-debt]
    reviewers: [devops-reviewer]
    output: "docs/debt-paydown-report.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "End-of-life deadline at risk → portfolio board": authority
      "Modernisation cancelled → back to register": stop
  - id: s2
    do: "Run fitness functions"
    owner: "Pipeline"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-4-1-s2-run-fitness-functions
    skills: [fitness-functions, parallel-run]
    reviewers: [quality-reviewer, reliability-reviewer, synthesiser]
    output: "docs/debt-paydown-report.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: d1
    decision: "Paid — passing, with interest removed?"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Engineering lead decides
    branches:
      "yes": s3
      "Fails → fix and re-run": s2
  - id: s3
    do: "Update register status"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-4-1-s3-update-register-status
    reviewers: [engineering-reviewer]
    output: "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s4
    do: "Report to the portfolio review"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-3-4-1-s4-report-to-the-portfolio-review
    skills: [dora-metrics]
    reviewers: [devops-reviewer]
    output: "docs/debt-paydown-report.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
gate: "Paydown verified"
criteria:
  - "Fitness function passing"
  - "Interest removed"
checks:
  - "Engineering lead verification"
on_failure:
  - "Fitness function on zero use of the old path"
  - "Portfolio board decides finish or roll back"
rework: "Failing fitness function → fix and re-run"
outputs:
  - "docs/debt-paydown-report.md"
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
handoff: "Debt paydown report → 8.4.1 Assemble the Portfolio Review Pack"
learning:
  - "Paydowns that stalled and why — learning log"
```

files.body:
# Workflow 8.4.1.1 · Assemble the Review Pack

Pull the outcome, value, insight, debt and run-cost evidence into one pack with a separate recommendation and circulate it before quarterly planning.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-4-1-1-review-pack.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-4-1-1-run-review-pack`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-4-1-1-review-pack
title: "Assemble the Review Pack"
owner: "Product manager"
inputs:
  - "docs/outcome-report.md"
  - "docs/value-reconciliation.md"
  - "docs/insight-synthesis.md"
  - "docs/improvement-backlog.md"
  - "docs/tech-debt-register.md"
  - "docs/modernisation-plan.md"
preconditions:
  - "Outcome report or interim readings available"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Collect outcome, value & insight evidence"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-4-1-1-s1-collect-outcome-value-and-insight-evidence
    skills: [benefits-realisation-management]
    reviewers: [product-reviewer, customer-reviewer, synthesiser]
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "Initiative closed → archive": stop
  - id: s2
    do: "Add debt, run cost & capacity"
    owner: "Engineering lead"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-4-1-1-s2-add-debt-run-cost-and-capacity
    skills: [cost-of-delay]
    reviewers: [engineering-reviewer, operations-reviewer]
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s3
    do: "Write the recommendation"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-4-1-1-s3-write-the-recommendation
    skills: [decision-record, weighted-scoring]
    reviewers: [finance-reviewer]
    output: "docs/portfolio-review-pack.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: d1
    decision: "Pack complete & evidence-led?"
    owner: "Sponsor"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Sponsor decides
    branches:
      "yes": s4
      "Evidence missing → complete": s1
      "Cross-initiative strategy shift → board chair": authority
  - id: s4
    do: "Circulate to the board"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-4-1-1-s4-circulate-to-the-board
    skills: [portfolio-review, lean-portfolio-management]
    reviewers: [business-reviewer]
    output: "docs/portfolio-review-pack.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
gate: "Pack complete"
criteria:
  - "Every criterion shown"
  - "Run cost included"
checks:
  - "Completeness check"
on_failure:
  - "Initiative moves to the next review slot"
  - "Split the recommendation onto its own page"
rework: "Evidence missing → complete the pack"
outputs:
  - "docs/portfolio-review-pack.md"
handoff: "Portfolio review pack → 8.4.2 Evaluate Options"
learning:
  - "Evidence the board asked for that the pack lacked — learning log"
```

# Workflow 8.4.2.1 · Score the Options

Describe iterate, scale, modernise, pivot and retire for this initiative, estimate and score each on evidence, and test the recommendation with an independent challenge.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-4-2-1-score-options.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-4-2-1-run-score-options`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-4-2-1-score-options
title: "Score the Options"
owner: "Product manager"
inputs:
  - "docs/portfolio-review-pack.md"
preconditions:
  - "Pack complete"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Describe the five options"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-4-2-1-s1-describe-the-five-options
    skills: [7-rs-of-modernisation, lean-portfolio-management]
    reviewers: [business-reviewer, customer-reviewer]
    output: "docs/options-appraisal.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
    on:
      "Nothing left worth doing → recommend close": stop
  - id: s2
    do: "Estimate value, cost & risk"
    owner: "Finance partner"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-4-2-1-s2-estimate-value-cost-and-risk
    skills: [four-big-risks, cost-of-delay]
    reviewers: [finance-reviewer, architecture-reviewer, vendor-reviewer]
    output: "docs/options-appraisal.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s3
    do: "Score with the agreed model"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-4-2-1-s3-score-with-the-agreed-model
    skills: [weighted-scoring, wsjf, scoring-workshop]
    reviewers: [product-reviewer, challenger]
    output: "docs/options-appraisal.md"
    checkpoint: review-at-end
  - id: s4
    do: "Challenge the recommendation"
    owner: "Challenger (peer or AI)"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-4-2-1-s4-challenge-the-recommendation
    skills: [pre-mortem]
    reviewers: [governance-reviewer, legal-reviewer]
    output: "docs/review-record.md"

    decision: "Recommendation holds?"
    owner: "Sponsor"

      "yes": gate

  - "Evidence per score"

  - "Independent challenge"
on_failure:

  - "docs/options-appraisal.md"
handoff: "Portfolio options appraisal → 8.4.3 Make the Portfolio Decision"

  - "Options the board picked against the scores, and why — learning log"
```

```yaml
inputs:
```

```yaml
  - "docs/options-appraisal.md"
preconditions:
  - "Options assessed"
  - "Board quorate"
steps:
  - id: s1

    owner: "Product manager"

      "yes": s3
```

# AGENTS.md — {{initiative}}

> Node SDLC · Act VIII EVOLVE · Scale: Product team. Read this first, every session.

## How we work
People own the work, agents help do it. In every unit the person in the role briefs the agent, gives it the right context, checks what it produces, and makes every decision. The agent drafts, researches, analyses, structures and checks — it never decides, approves or signs.
- **You:** Choose what to work on · give context · make decisions · review and correct · sign off · own the artifact
- **Your agent:** Draft · research · summarise · structure into templates · spot gaps and risks · check against criteria · prepare options

## Where this act sits
EVOLVE is part of the **Run & learn** — Is it working, and what did we learn? The acts keep their order as a logical dependency — a problem is validated before it is planned, designed before it is built — but they are kinds of work that run continuously and in parallel, at different sizes, not phases on a calendar.

## EVOLVE: Measure real outcomes against what was promised, learn from everything the running product tells us, keep it healthy, and decide on evidence to iterate, scale, modernise, pivot or retire.
- **8.1 Outcome Measurement** — gate: Outcome Review. Produces: Outcome measurement plan, Baseline record, Outcome readings log, Outcome report, Realised value reconciliation.
- **8.2 Feedback & Insight Synthesis** — gate: Insight Review. Produces: Signal inventory, Insight synthesis, Improvement backlog, Feedback response, Cycle retrospective, Learning log.
- **8.3 Tech Debt & Modernisation** — gate: Debt & Modernisation Review. Produces: Tech-debt register, Debt interest assessment, Modernisation plan, Debt paydown report.
- **8.4 Portfolio Review** — gate: Portfolio Decision. Produces: Portfolio review pack, Portfolio options appraisal, Portfolio decision record, Portfolio backlog, Opportunity signal / request, Request log entry, Product backlog entry, Learning log.
- **8.5 Retirement & Decommission** — gate: Decommission Sign-off. Produces: Retirement plan, Sunset notice, Transition tracker, Data disposition record, Deletion certificate, Decommission record.
- Act gate: **Portfolio Decision** — decided by: Product manager judges outcomes and the sponsor co-signs; the portfolio board makes the Portfolio Decision; the executive decides above the board's authority..

## Conventions
- Artifacts live in `docs/<artifact>.md`, written from `templates/<artifact>.md`.
- Every artifact carries its trace ID and links the IDs upstream of it; register new IDs in `TRACE.md`.
- Trace chain: OUT → INS → IMP → TDR → MOD → PDC → RET → LRN.
- Log each step in `PROGRESS.md`.
- Before saving, score the artifact against `rubrics/<artifact>.md`.

## Your toolkit
- `commands/` — one per step, workflow, subprocess, process and the act. Start with `evolve-run-act` or the unit you're on.
- `workflows/` — run specs with checkpoints; stop at every checkpoint.
- `skills/` — how-to packages for each technique; load the ones a command names.
- `agents/` — reviewers by lens, plus researcher, synthesiser, challenger and decision-brief writer.
- `TOOLS.md` and `GUARDRAILS.md` — what you may use and must never do.

## Ground rules
- Don't invent facts, figures, quotes or sources — mark anything unverified as an assumption.
- If something you need is missing, ask me instead of guessing.
- Keep personal or confidential data out unless I've provided it for this purpose.
- Prepare decisions; don't make them — I decide.

## Scale: Product team
Write for a product trio and a delivery team. Use our shared templates, make outputs ready to drop into the backlog or repository, and flag anything that needs the team's refinement.
Access: Read and write the shared workspace and backlog; agents propose changes, people merge and publish.

# Guardrails & hooks — Evolve

People own the work, agents help do it. In every unit the person in the role briefs the agent, gives it the right context, checks what it produces, and makes every decision. The agent drafts, researches, analyses, structures and checks — it never decides, approves or signs.

## Always
- Don't invent facts, figures, quotes or sources — mark anything unverified as an assumption.
- If something you need is missing, ask me instead of guessing.
- Keep personal or confidential data out unless I've provided it for this purpose.
- Prepare decisions; don't make them — I decide.
- Never paste passwords, keys, or personal data you aren't allowed to share — anonymise first
- At enterprise scale, use only approved tools
- Check every fact, number and source the agent gives you
- Agents prepare decisions; people make them
- Save the output in the artifact template and note that an agent helped
- If the agent's output is wrong, correct the prompt or the context — then record what you learned

## Scale: Product team
- Read and write the shared workspace and backlog; agents propose changes, people merge and publish.
- Watch for: Each person's agent producing inconsistent artifacts — use the shared templates
- Watch for: Discovery and delivery drifting apart

## Hooks — automatic where your agent supports them, a checklist everywhere else
| When | Check | If it fails |
|---|---|---|
| Before saving an artifact | It follows its template · it carries its trace ID and links upstream IDs · every claim cites evidence or is marked 'Assumption:' · no personal data or secrets | Fix, or stop and tell me |
| Before a decision step | Stop. Prepare the decision brief. Wait for the named decision-maker | Never decide or approve |
| Before anything leaves the team | Messages, posts, invitations and shared documents are drafts until a person sends them | Ask for approval |
| Before using a new tool or data source | Is it allowed at this scale? Is the data allowed in this tool? | Ask first |
| After each step | Append to PROGRESS.md: date, unit, what was done, artifacts, decisions, open questions, next | Always |

- No decision by default — 'carry on' is a recorded decision
- Records under retention are never deleted
- Outcome reviews at every by-date

- Capacity allocation for debt agreed each quarter
- Targets fixed by the brief
- Quarterly planning cadence
- Retention law

# AGENTS.md — {{initiative}}

> Node SDLC · Act VIII EVOLVE · Scale: Enterprise. Read this first, every session.

## How we work
People own the work, agents help do it. In every unit the person in the role briefs the agent, gives it the right context, checks what it produces, and makes every decision. The agent drafts, researches, analyses, structures and checks — it never decides, approves or signs.
- **You:** Choose what to work on · give context · make decisions · review and correct · sign off · own the artifact
- **Your agent:** Draft · research · summarise · structure into templates · spot gaps and risks · check against criteria · prepare options

## Where this act sits
EVOLVE is part of the **Run & learn** — Is it working, and what did we learn? The acts keep their order as a logical dependency — a problem is validated before it is planned, designed before it is built — but they are kinds of work that run continuously and in parallel, at different sizes, not phases on a calendar.

## EVOLVE: Measure real outcomes against what was promised, learn from everything the running product tells us, keep it healthy, and decide on evidence to iterate, scale, modernise, pivot or retire.
- **8.1 Outcome Measurement** — gate: Outcome Review. Produces: Outcome measurement plan, Baseline record, Outcome readings log, Outcome report, Realised value reconciliation.
- **8.2 Feedback & Insight Synthesis** — gate: Insight Review. Produces: Signal inventory, Insight synthesis, Improvement backlog, Feedback response, Cycle retrospective, Learning log.
- **8.3 Tech Debt & Modernisation** — gate: Debt & Modernisation Review. Produces: Tech-debt register, Debt interest assessment, Modernisation plan, Debt paydown report.
- **8.4 Portfolio Review** — gate: Portfolio Decision. Produces: Portfolio review pack, Portfolio options appraisal, Portfolio decision record, Portfolio backlog, Opportunity signal / request, Request log entry, Product backlog entry, Learning log.
- **8.5 Retirement & Decommission** — gate: Decommission Sign-off. Produces: Retirement plan, Sunset notice, Transition tracker, Data disposition record, Deletion certificate, Decommission record.
- Act gate: **Portfolio Decision** — decided by: Product manager judges outcomes and the sponsor co-signs; the portfolio board makes the Portfolio Decision; the executive decides above the board's authority..

## Conventions
- Artifacts live in `docs/<artifact>.md`, written from `templates/<artifact>.md`.
- Every artifact carries its trace ID and links the IDs upstream of it; register new IDs in `TRACE.md`.
- Trace chain: OUT → INS → IMP → TDR → MOD → PDC → RET → LRN.
- Log each step in `PROGRESS.md`.
- Before saving, score the artifact against `rubrics/<artifact>.md`.

## Your toolkit
- `commands/` — one per step, workflow, subprocess, process and the act. Start with `evolve-run-act` or the unit you're on.
- `workflows/` — run specs with checkpoints; stop at every checkpoint.
- `skills/` — how-to packages for each technique; load the ones a command names.
- `agents/` — reviewers by lens, plus researcher, synthesiser, challenger and decision-brief writer.
- `TOOLS.md` and `GUARDRAILS.md` — what you may use and must never do.

## Ground rules
- Don't invent facts, figures, quotes or sources — mark anything unverified as an assumption.
- If something you need is missing, ask me instead of guessing.
- Keep personal or confidential data out unless I've provided it for this purpose.
- Prepare decisions; don't make them — I decide.

## Scale: Enterprise
Use formal language and our approved templates. Back every claim with a reference to its evidence for audit, flag compliance, security and privacy implications, name the approver for each decision, and keep confidential details out of anything meant for wider sharing.
Access: Approved tools only; read-only on customer and production data; every write goes through review; agent actions logged for audit.
enterprise.GUARDRAILS.md:
# Guardrails & hooks — Evolve

People own the work, agents help do it. In every unit the person in the role briefs the agent, gives it the right context, checks what it produces, and makes every decision. The agent drafts, researches, analyses, structures and checks — it never decides, approves or signs.

## Always
- Don't invent facts, figures, quotes or sources — mark anything unverified as an assumption.
- If something you need is missing, ask me instead of guessing.
- Keep personal or confidential data out unless I've provided it for this purpose.
- Prepare decisions; don't make them — I decide.
- Never paste passwords, keys, or personal data you aren't allowed to share — anonymise first
- At enterprise scale, use only approved tools
- Check every fact, number and source the agent gives you
- Agents prepare decisions; people make them
- Save the output in the artifact template and note that an agent helped
- If the agent's output is wrong, correct the prompt or the context — then record what you learned

## Scale: Enterprise
- Approved tools only; read-only on customer and production data; every write goes through review; agent actions logged for audit.
- Watch for: Pasting confidential or personal data into unapproved tools
- Watch for: Agent output in audited artifacts without a human reviewer named

## Hooks — automatic where your agent supports them, a checklist everywhere else
| When | Check | If it fails |
|---|---|---|
| Before saving an artifact | It follows its template · it carries its trace ID and links upstream IDs · every claim cites evidence or is marked 'Assumption:' · no personal data or secrets | Fix, or stop and tell me |
| Before a decision step | Stop. Prepare the decision brief. Wait for the named decision-maker | Never decide or approve |
| Before anything leaves the team | Messages, posts, invitations and shared documents are drafts until a person sends them | Ask for approval |
| Before using a new tool or data source | Is it allowed at this scale? Is the data allowed in this tool? | Ask first |
| After each step | Append to PROGRESS.md: date, unit, what was done, artifacts, decisions, open questions, next | Always |

# Workflow 8.1.1.1 · Define the Outcome Measures

Turn every success criterion and the value hypothesis from the brief into a defined metric with baseline source, target, by-date, recorder and judge.

**Run it:** ask your agent to "run `workflows/evolve-8-1-1-1-define-measures.md` for {{initiative}}, stopping at every checkpoint", or use the command `evolve-8-1-1-1-run-define-measures`. Each checkpoint means: show me the output and wait. At `decision` checkpoints the named person decides.

```yaml
workflow: evolve-8-1-1-1-define-measures
title: "Define the Outcome Measures"
owner: "Product manager"
inputs:
  - "docs/opportunity-brief.md"
  - "docs/decision-record.md"
preconditions:
  - "Change released or release date known"
steps:
  - id: s1
    do: "Extract criteria & value hypothesis"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-1-1-1-s1-extract-criteria-and-value-hypothesis
    skills: [benefits-realisation-management]
    reviewers: [business-reviewer, product-reviewer, challenger]
    output: "docs/measurement-plan.md"
    checkpoint: review
  - id: s2
    do: "Define each metric"
    owner: "Data analyst"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-1-1-1-s2-define-each-metric
    skills: [goal-question-metric]
    reviewers: [data-reviewer]
    output: "docs/measurement-plan.md"
    checkpoint: review
    on:
      "Nothing measurable → back to DISCOVER": stop
  - id: s3
    do: "Add leading indicators & guardrails"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-1-1-1-s3-add-leading-indicators-and-guardrails
    skills: [leading-and-lagging-indicators, heart-framework, comparison-group]
    reviewers: [ux-reviewer, finance-reviewer]
    output: "docs/measurement-plan.md"
    checkpoint: review
  - id: s4
    do: "Name recorder, judge & by-dates"
    owner: "Product manager"
    agent: "draft, then wait for review"
    command: evolve-8-1-1-1-s4-name-recorder-judge-and-by-dates
    reviewers: [governance-reviewer]
    output: "docs/measurement-plan.md"
    checkpoint: review
  - id: d1
    decision: "Sponsor agrees the plan?"
    owner: "Sponsor"
    agent: "prepare a decision brief — never decide"
    checkpoint: decision   # stop; Sponsor decides
    branches:
      "yes": gate
      "Definition disputed → redefine": s2
      "Target change requested → portfolio board": authority
gate: "Measurement plan agreed"
criteria:
  - "Every brief criterion present"
  - "Recorder ≠ judge"
checks:
  - "Analyst confirms each metric is computable"
on_failure:
  - "Restore the brief's criteria and add the easier metric as a leading indicator"
  - "Add a guardrail before the first reading"
rework: "Disputed definition → redefine with the analyst"
outputs:
  - "docs/measurement-plan.md"
handoff: "Outcome measurement plan → 8.1.2 Confirm Baselines & Instrumentation"
learning:
  - "Criteria that proved hard to measure — learning log"
```

# AGENTS.md — {{initiative}}

> Node SDLC · Act VIII EVOLVE · Scale: Platform. Read this first, every session.

## How we work
People own the work, agents help do it. In every unit the person in the role briefs the agent, gives it the right context, checks what it produces, and makes every decision. The agent drafts, researches, analyses, structures and checks — it never decides, approves or signs.
- **You:** Choose what to work on · give context · make decisions · review and correct · sign off · own the artifact
- **Your agent:** Draft · research · summarise · structure into templates · spot gaps and risks · check against criteria · prepare options

## Where this act sits
EVOLVE is part of the **Run & learn** — Is it working, and what did we learn? The acts keep their order as a logical dependency — a problem is validated before it is planned, designed before it is built — but they are kinds of work that run continuously and in parallel, at different sizes, not phases on a calendar.

## EVOLVE: Measure real outcomes against what was promised, learn from everything the running product tells us, keep it healthy, and decide on evidence to iterate, scale, modernise, pivot or retire.
- **8.1 Outcome Measurement** — gate: Outcome Review. Produces: Outcome measurement plan, Baseline record, Outcome readings log, Outcome report, Realised value reconciliation.
- **8.2 Feedback & Insight Synthesis** — gate: Insight Review. Produces: Signal inventory, Insight synthesis, Improvement backlog, Feedback response, Cycle retrospective, Learning log.
- **8.3 Tech Debt & Modernisation** — gate: Debt & Modernisation Review. Produces: Tech-debt register, Debt interest assessment, Modernisation plan, Debt paydown report.
- **8.4 Portfolio Review** — gate: Portfolio Decision. Produces: Portfolio review pack, Portfolio options appraisal, Portfolio decision record, Portfolio backlog, Opportunity signal / request, Request log entry, Product backlog entry, Learning log.
- **8.5 Retirement & Decommission** — gate: Decommission Sign-off. Produces: Retirement plan, Sunset notice, Transition tracker, Data disposition record, Deletion certificate, Decommission record.
- Act gate: **Portfolio Decision** — decided by: Product manager judges outcomes and the sponsor co-signs; the portfolio board makes the Portfolio Decision; the executive decides above the board's authority..

## Conventions
- Artifacts live in `docs/<artifact>.md`, written from `templates/<artifact>.md`.
- Every artifact carries its trace ID and links the IDs upstream of it; register new IDs in `TRACE.md`.
- Trace chain: OUT → INS → IMP → TDR → MOD → PDC → RET → LRN.
- Log each step in `PROGRESS.md`.
- Before saving, score the artifact against `rubrics/<artifact>.md`.

## Your toolkit
- `commands/` — one per step, workflow, subprocess, process and the act. Start with `evolve-run-act` or the unit you're on.
- `workflows/` — run specs with checkpoints; stop at every checkpoint.
- `skills/` — how-to packages for each technique; load the ones a command names.
- `agents/` — reviewers by lens, plus researcher, synthesiser, challenger and decision-brief writer.
- `TOOLS.md` and `GUARDRAILS.md` — what you may use and must never do.

## Ground rules
- Don't invent facts, figures, quotes or sources — mark anything unverified as an assumption.
- If something you need is missing, ask me instead of guessing.
- Keep personal or confidential data out unless I've provided it for this purpose.
- Prepare decisions; don't make them — I decide.

## Scale: Platform
Treat other internal teams as the customers. Capture their needs as service or API contracts, and consider versioning, backward compatibility, self-service, documentation and adoption.
Access: Read and write the platform repository and API docs in branches; consuming teams' systems are read-only.

# Guardrails & hooks — Evolve

People own the work, agents help do it. In every unit the person in the role briefs the agent, gives it the right context, checks what it produces, and makes every decision. The agent drafts, researches, analyses, structures and checks — it never decides, approves or signs.

## Always
- Don't invent facts, figures, quotes or sources — mark anything unverified as an assumption.
- If something you need is missing, ask me instead of guessing.
- Keep personal or confidential data out unless I've provided it for this purpose.
- Prepare decisions; don't make them — I decide.
- Never paste passwords, keys, or personal data you aren't allowed to share — anonymise first
- At enterprise scale, use only approved tools
- Check every fact, number and source the agent gives you
- Agents prepare decisions; people make them
- Save the output in the artifact template and note that an agent helped
- If the agent's output is wrong, correct the prompt or the context — then record what you learned

## Scale: Platform
- Read and write the platform repository and API docs in branches; consuming teams' systems are read-only.
- Watch for: Building what the platform team finds interesting, not what consumers need
- Watch for: Breaking changes without versioning

## Hooks — automatic where your agent supports them, a checklist everywhere else
| When | Check | If it fails |
|---|---|---|
| Before saving an artifact | It follows its template · it carries its trace ID and links upstream IDs · every claim cites evidence or is marked 'Assumption:' · no personal data or secrets | Fix, or stop and tell me |
| Before a decision step | Stop. Prepare the decision brief. Wait for the named decision-maker | Never decide or approve |
| Before anything leaves the team | Messages, posts, invitations and shared documents are drafts until a person sends them | Ask for approval |
| Before using a new tool or data source | Is it allowed at this scale? Is the data allowed in this tool? | Ask first |
| After each step | Append to PROGRESS.md: date, unit, what was done, artifacts, decisions, open questions, next | Always |

- Targets from the brief are not moved in EVOLVE
